title: Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 — Section 20 (Cognizance of cases by Lok Adalat)

content.overview: Section 20 states when a Lok Adalat may take cognizance of a case, including on reference by a court and on application by a party.
content.glance: Section 20 states when a Lok Adalat may take cognizance of a case, including on reference by a court and on application by a party.
content.study: A Lok Adalat takes cognizance when a court refers a pending case, when a party applies, or when the Authority organises a Lok Adalat for a pre-litigation dispute. Cognizance is the gateway to a settlement award under section 21.
